assessment_rules: The midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate. The overall grade is calculated from the midterm (35%), homework (30%), and final exam (35%).
